speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Myasthenia Gravis.

The positive Acetylcholine Receptor Antibody test, combined with your symptoms of weakness worsening by the end of the day and difficulty with self-care or specific tasks like rising from a chair or brushing your teeth, confirms this diagnosis. Normal CK and TSH levels rule out muscular dystrophy and thyroid disorders.
